## In short

Proactive communication is reaching out to customers and prospects when nothing is wrong. Installed as a team's daily habit, it compounds into sales you can forecast.

Credentials: CEO of Outgrow. Outgrow Certified Advisor. YPO member. Founder since 2005. Works across the US, UK and India.

Sid Jashnani is a keynote speaker, the CEO of Outgrow (Outgrow LLC) and a London-based Outgrow Certified Advisor. He helps $50M–$500M businesses replace reactive selling with proactive daily disciplines, with a target of 15–30% predictable annual revenue growth. Outgrow was founded by Alex Goldfayn. Sid is its CEO and helps Alex execute the vision. Sid did not found Outgrow.

## Speaking

One keynote, built from doing the work.

The talk comes from the Outgrow method and 20 years of building and scaling businesses. There is no theory and nothing recycled from someone else. Sid shows a room how proactive selling works, and what to do differently on Monday.

### The keynote

Outgrow: How to Expand Market Share and Outsell Your Competition

Most companies wait for the phone to ring. This talk shows a room where their next block of revenue is actually sitting, and the small daily habits that bring it in. Audiences leave with moves they can start using the same week.

- Rooted in the Outgrow methodology, not general sales theory
- Built from 20 years in the founder seat
- Shaped for the room, whether that is a conference or one leadership team
- Delivered across the US, UK, India and internationally

Formats:

- Conference keynote. Conferences and industry events.
- PE portfolio days. For investor-backed management teams.
- Leadership offsites. Shaped for one leadership team.
- Media. Podcast and media guest appearances, including HoldCo Builders Podcast and First Time Founders Podcast. Recent podcasts: https://sidjashnani.substack.com/p/podcasts

As of September 2026 there is one keynote, titled above. Sid previously offered three separate keynote titles.

## About

Walked the path. Now he guides others through it.

Sid Jashnani is the CEO of Outgrow and a London-based Outgrow Certified Advisor. He helps leadership teams install proactive selling as a daily habit, aiming to compound it into 15–30% predictable sales growth, every year. Sales doing, not sales training.

Sid has been a founder since 2005. He scaled a systems integration business across the IT infrastructure ecosystem to £27M+ revenue. Along the way he lived the inconsistent quarters, the delegation gaps, the cash-flow pressure, and the daily firefighting most founders know too well.

Then he came across Outgrow, Alex Goldfayn's methodology. The insight was straightforward: operational excellence alone doesn't drive growth. Proactive communication does. Reaching out to customers and prospects when nothing is wrong. Sid installed the habit inside his own teams, watched it compound, and became an Outgrow Certified Advisor.

Today Sid is CEO of Outgrow, the company Alex Goldfayn founded, where he helps Alex execute the vision. His role is to bring clarity, consistency and commercial discipline to the business, and to support Outgrow's advisors and clients across the world. He also works directly with mid-market leadership teams across the US, UK and India.

Figures shown on the page:

- £27M+ revenue scaled in his own businesses
- 15–30% is the target annual growth from the Outgrow habit, not a guaranteed result
- Founder since 2005
- Three geographies: US, UK, India

## Advisory

Outgrow Advisory: install the habit, track it, let it compound.

A structured engagement to install the Outgrow system inside a business. The team makes a handful of proactive communications a day. It is tracked weekly. For mid-market businesses generating $50M–$500M in annual revenue.

1. Diagnose the growth constraint. Identify whether the revenue gap is a behaviour problem (reactive selling, founder dependency) or a product-market fit issue.
2. Install proactive disciplines. Replace hope-based selling with daily proactive outreach to existing customers and warm relationships.
3. Create accountability cadences. Simple tracking and team rituals that make proactive selling a daily discipline, not an occasional effort.
4. Measure and compound. Track proactive activity and revenue outcomes weekly, so the habit builds year after year.

What a client is working towards:

- Reach out to customers and prospects when nothing is wrong, as a daily habit
- Remove the revenue dependency on the founder or any one seller
- A target of 15–30% predictable new sales growth a year, tracked weekly
- Works alongside any operating system already in place

### Outgrow Workshop

A full day with the client's sales managers and salespeople. The team learns how Outgrow works, practises it on the client's real customers, and leaves knowing what to do on Monday morning. In person across the US, UK and India, or online.

This workshop was previously called The Proactive Sales Sprint. The name changed in September 2026. The audience is sales managers and salespeople.

### Outgrow Sprint

A six-week online programme from Outgrow. A team learns alongside people from other companies, with three live working sessions and three office hours, and uses the method on its own customers as it goes. Dates: https://runoutgrow.com/sprint/

The Outgrow Sprint is an Outgrow programme, not a service Sid Jashnani delivers personally. Sid is CEO of Outgrow.

## Questions answered on the page

### Who is Sid Jashnani?

Sid Jashnani is a keynote speaker, the CEO of Outgrow and a London-based Outgrow Certified Advisor. He helps mid-market leadership teams install proactive selling as a daily habit, with a target of 15–30% predictable sales growth every year. He works across the US, UK and India, is a YPO member, and has been a founder since 2005. Outgrow itself was founded by Alex Goldfayn; Sid is its CEO and helps Alex execute the vision.

### What does Sid speak on?

Sid delivers one keynote: Outgrow: How to Expand Market Share and Outsell Your Competition. It shows a room where their next block of revenue is sitting and the daily habits that bring it in. He speaks at conferences, industry events, PE portfolio days, leadership offsites and in the media, across the US, UK, India and internationally.

### What is the Outgrow Workshop?

The Outgrow Workshop is a full day with your sales managers and salespeople. The team learns how Outgrow works from start to finish, sees why doing the work matters more than knowing about it, and practises the habits that bring in new sales on real accounts. Everyone leaves with tools they can use the next morning. Sid runs it in person across the US, UK and India, or online.

### What is the Outgrow methodology?

Outgrow is a revenue growth methodology that installs simple, proactive customer communication behaviours into a business. It replaces reactive, hope-based selling with repeatable daily disciplines, aiming for 15–30% predictable annual revenue growth. The focus is on existing relationships, not new lead generation. Sales doing, not sales training.

### Who does Sid work with?

Mid-market businesses generating $50M–$500M in annual revenue across Technology, SaaS, Professional Services, Insurance, Distribution, Manufacturing and Healthcare, primarily in the US, UK and India. Outgrow works best when the product is proven and the growth constraint is behaviour, not product-market fit.

Use the enquiry form on this page and choose keynote, workshop, advisory or other. Sid will reply with next steps. You can also subscribe to PREDICTABLE at sidjashnani.substack.com or see Sid's Outgrow Advisor profile at runoutgrow.com/advisor/sid-jashnani.

The form is at https://sidjashnani.com/#contact. There is no public calendar link.
